message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/ndpi && git log --oneline -20 -- src/lib/protocols/tls.c` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now let me understand the vulnerability. The crash is a Use-of-uninitialized-value in `processCertificateElements`. Let me look at the git history to understand what changed in the regression range (202112020603 to 202112080613).

Let me look at the git log for tls.c around that time.
